title: Claude Code 05: Prompt library se copy-paste prompts #shorts
description:
Claude Code 05: Prompt library. Claude Code docs me copy-paste prompts hain, task aur role ke hisaab se tag kiye hue. Teen pattern: steps nahi outcome batao, check karne ka tareeka do (run karke confirm karo), aur @ se file dikhao. Ye scripts nahi, starting points hain: Why this works kholkar pattern samjho aur apna prompt likho. Kaam ka prompt mile to use skill bana lo, phir wo slash command se chalega.

Source (official):
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-library

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: the docs crops are our own capture of the official page (key lines highlighted). The terminal window is an illustration using the page's example prompts. Synthetic voice.
